best.explanation: Rey Cortiço looks like a fun-sized north coast window for Rare window, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 78 kJ, 10 s period, workable consistency 60/100, and wind is the main risk.  An open beach break where the sandbanks decide everything; this is best for quiet, punchy peaks when Lagide is too small; 10-13s at low tide can still work well on Belgas, so checking exposed beaches makes sense.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
